The score is the sum of the recoded variables Rp3ceq5 Rp3ceq6 p3ceq7_tot Rp3ceq8 and Rp3ceq9 for cases with no missings on these items (p3ceqcc_miss2=0). The p3ceq7_tot variable is calculated, also according to the guidelines, by averaging the (non-missing) scores on Rp3ceq7a Rp3ceq7b Rp3ceq7c and Rp3ceq7d if Rp3ceq7a=yes. Values are 0 if Rp3ceq7a=no.
